input: Draft public testimony opposing Romanch's Law (Intro 943), a New York City Council bill that would phase out and ban horse-drawn carriages, from the perspective of a transit workers' union representing carriage drivers, focused on protecting driver jobs and livelihoods.
source_doc: NYC Intro 943 ("Romanch's Law"), introduced by Council Member Christopher Marte; first City Council Health Committee hearing July 15, 2026
